did: Built Takes' Needs your attention page (HEARD3): every take home couldn't hear well, one group per problem code, each playable, with keep it and record it again sent home and Delete through My data's own sheet and receipt for Studio takes. Shared Takes on home's play machine, Play button and chips with it rather than copying them, amended LA8, LA19 and CLAUDE.md for a second delete page, and prepared #912's ledger companion branch.

calls.title: C440: how a take with several codes is listed
options: once, under its first code, naming all, with a chip per code
once in every group it carries
one group per verdict, codes as pills
calls.why: The owner asked for grouping by each code, and a take can carry several; listing it once keeps one Play and one set of acts per take.
calls.undo: List a take under each of its codes in groupByCode and drop the chips.

calls.title: C441: the dot for a take waiting on the owner
options: a new meaning in the warning token
a new meaning in an unused chart token
calls.why: The dot table had no meaning for something waiting on the owner; warning stays apart from home's sky under every colour blindness.
calls.undo: Drop attention from DOT_MEANINGS and the dots that say it.

calls.title: C442: what Record it again does
options: a mark kept on home, no recorder on the page
a recorder on the page replacing the take
calls.why: Each kind records on its own screen and nothing said where a retake should go.
calls.undo: Have the again act open the kind's recorder through a port.

calls.title: C443: which takes offer Delete
options: every take, home refusing the rest
none until the owner switches the work's kinds on
calls.why: The owner said 'I should be able to delete them', but #2474 keeps the work (Rust Rounds, interview) for good; that choice is the owner's.
calls.undo: Add a kind to PHONE_LETS_GO once home's SWITCHED_ON takes it.
